spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence uses present continuous for an individual arrangement?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] They are moving into their new flat next weekend.
B. [WRONG] The new flat becomes available on the first of the month.
C. [WRONG] They moved into their flat last month.
D. [WRONG] They move house every few years.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: The new flat becomes available on the first of the month., They moved into their flat last month., They move house every few years.
